facebook.content:
When you view marriage as a covenant kingdom partnership, not a contract, every disagreement becomes a holy battle for the throne you share. Ephesians 5:31 declares, “…a man shall leave his father and mother and be joined to his wife, and the two shall become one flesh.” The “one flesh” is a united kingdom under Christ, not a compromise of wills.  

If you treat your marriage as a joint reign, how will you change the way you respond to conflict today?

instagram.content:
Authority isn’t a title; it’s a throne we claim in Christ.  
When you sit at the “king’s table” (1 Cor 10:31) you’re not asking permission—you’re exercising the dominion already given you.  
Every decision, every word, reflects the Kingdom’s rule over your life.  

What will you do today that declares you’re already seated in that authority?
